reason: Five provider adapter gaps left by #486, #488, #499 and #504. (1) Tool calls recovered from assistant text (DSML, GLM <tool_call>, DeepSeek special tokens) are read in the ModelResponse validator, which never saw the request, so they kept the wire name the model was shown: a dotted Nebula tool such as tool_output.search, sent as tool_output_search, came back under the wrong name. Adapters now build their responses through _adapter_response(request, ...), which passes the request as pydantic validation context, and the validator decodes each recovered name with _decode_tool_name exactly as structured calls are decoded (all six construction sites: Responses, Chat Completions complete and stream, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock). (2) Stream ERROR events carried only text, so chat raised ChatError for a refusal, spent quota or an overflow on the streamed paths while complete() raised the typed error. ModelStreamEvent gains error_kind (refusal, context_length, quota, overloaded, tool_call, malformed_tool_call, response), set by ModelStreamEvent.failure(exc) at both ERROR sites, and provider_error() rebuilds the typed error (a refusal keeps its reason). Chat's plain-stream and final-synthesis ERROR branches raise event.provider_error() or, for an unclassified failure, the ChatError they raised before, so a refusal reaches the operator as ProviderRefusalError with its reason and spent quota as ProviderQuotaError (an overflow keeps flagging context_length_exceeded, which _stream_with_context_recovery turns into recovery on both paths since #508); test_native_adapter_outcomes.py::test_refused_synthesis_reaches_the_operator_without_recovery pinned the old ChatError and now expects ProviderRefusalError. (3) _path treated only /v<digits> bases as versioned, so DeepSeek's https://api.deepseek.com/beta base got /beta/v1/chat/completions; /beta now counts as a version segment (LiteLLM's DeepSeek base takes /chat/completions directly). (4) #486 turned botocore retries off, so a Bedrock connection that never opened (EndpointConnectionError, ConnectTimeoutError) was no longer retried; _bedrock_failure classifies both as ProviderOverloadedError so the existing retry loop resends them, while a ReadTimeoutError is still never resent. (5) Qwen/Hermes <tool_call>{"name": ..., "arguments": ...}</tool_call> JSON was neither recovered nor quarantined; tool_markup reads it (markup 'hermes') all-or-nothing (exactly name and arguments, a valid tool name, arguments an object or a JSON string of one, no repeated keys), quarantines a frame whose tag opens an object keyed name or arguments, and holds such a tag back while streaming, with GLM frames still read by their own grammar. The listed defect 'leading finish_reason error frame is not replayed' does not reproduce on origin/main: _leading_frames already replays a leading frame whose only content is a transient finish reason, and 'error' is in _TRANSIENT_FINISH_REASONS (#499), so no change was made for it. tests/v3/test_provider_leftovers.py (65 tests; 60 fail on origin/main, 5 are regression guards that pass on both) proves each fix through the real adapters and ChatService; the other selected node ids are the existing tests that directly exercise the changed stream-error, base-path, Bedrock retry and markup code.
exclusions: Scoped per the CI-scoping rule: test_providers.py, test_native_tool_markup.py, test_deepseek_glm_compat.py, test_dsml.py, test_native_adapter_outcomes.py, test_native_adapter_requests.py, test_openai_compatible_robustness.py, test_openai_compatible_parameters.py, test_provider_contracts.py, test_provider_verification.py, test_tool_call_assembly.py, test_reasoning_replay.py, test_reasoning_recovery.py, test_reasoning_controls.py, test_routing_prose_answer.py, test_synthesis_tool_declarations.py, test_malformed_tool_call_feedback.py, test_chat_final_synthesis_recovery.py, test_chat_routing_tolerance.py, test_specialist_routing_tolerance.py, test_specialist_tool_batches.py, test_inference_timeouts_probe_budget.py, test_model_output_budget.py, test_chat.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_chat_api.py, test_chat_subagents.py, test_harness_provider_subagents.py, test_native_hook_turn_ends.py, test_context.py, test_missions.py, test_orchestration.py, test_diagnostics.py, test_api.py and test_in_turn_context_pruning.py were run locally in full and pass but are not selected. No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through providers.py and chat.py) talks to a stub provider that never serializes tool markup, reports a typed stream error, uses a /beta base or Bedrock; the Python tests drive the adapters and ChatService directly. No full suites.
